columns.header: Global Axis Forces and Moments [Note (1)] Fx, N (lb) (Unsigned) [Notes (2), (3)]

notes: GENERAL NOTE: The stress due to sustained load used in determining the eq. (1b) allowable displacement stress range, SA, for nodes 20 and 320 is 28.4 MPa (4.12 ksi).

(1) Force ranges, moment ranges, and displacement stress ranges are averaged from commercial programs’ results, are obtained by analyzing the piping system in both U.S. Customary and SI units, and are directly affected by the stiffness chosen for valves, flanges, other relatively stiff components, and branch connections.
(2) In accordance with para. 319.4.4, no operating pressure force range is included in the force ranges and displacement stress ranges listed above.

(3) Signs are not listed for Fx and My listed above since signs are irrelevant following the load combination summation; see paras. 319.2.3(b), 319.3.1(a), 319.4.4, and 302.3.5(d) in determining the greatest displacement stress range, SE.
